flashcard_questions.q: How old was Elizabeth when she became queen?

flashcard_questions.a: The royal family descended from Henry VII.

flashcard_questions.q: Why did Elizabeth’s lack of an heir threaten England?
flashcard_questions.a: The Tudor line would end with her, risking civil war.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Catholic claimant would have taken the throne without a Protestant heir?
Which English suitor was Elizabeth’s childhood friend and clear favourite?
In which year was Dudley’s wife Amy Robsart found dead?
Why did Amy Robsart’s death ruin Dudley’s chances of marrying Elizabeth?
flashcard_questions.a: Rivals spread rumours that he had murdered her.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Spanish king proposed marriage to Elizabeth?
Which port did England lose because of Mary I’s marriage to Philip II?
What nickname did Elizabeth give Francis, Duke of Anjou?
How much younger than Elizabeth was the Duke of Anjou?
Why did the St Bartholomew’s Day Massacre of 1572 harm his suit?
flashcard_questions.a: It turned English opinion against a French Catholic prince.

flashcard_questions.q: How long did Elizabeth use the possibility of marriage as a diplomatic tool?
Why did Elizabeth fear that marrying would cost her power?
flashcard_questions.a: Tudor husbands were in charge of their wives.

flashcard_questions.q: What image did Elizabeth build by staying unmarried?
flashcard_questions.a: The “Virgin Queen”, married only to her kingdom.
